pages.text: 五一假期的早上，太阳刚刚升起来。爸爸把帐篷、折叠椅和野餐篮统统塞进了车里。咘咘抱着自己的小水壶，兴奋地蹦来蹦去：「我们要去露营啦！」NOMI帮忙拎着毯子，NONO站在车顶上指挥：「这个放左边！那个放右边！」Coco背着一个小背包，笑着说：「Let's go camping!」
pages.text_en: On the morning of May Day holiday, the sun was just rising. Dad stuffed the tent, folding chairs, and picnic basket into the car. Bubu held her little water bottle and bounced around excitedly: "We're going camping!" NOMI helped carry the blanket, while NONO stood on the car roof directing: "Put this on the left! That on the right!" Coco wore a little backpack and smiled: "Let's go camping!"

pages.text: 车子开了好一会儿，终于到了湖边。哇——蓝蓝的天，白白的云，湖水清清的，像一面大镜子！妈妈牵着咘咘的手，温柔地说：「你看，多美呀。」咘咘张大了嘴巴，眼睛亮晶晶的：「好漂亮的湖！」
pages.text_en: After a long drive, they finally arrived at the lake. Wow — blue sky, white clouds, and crystal-clear water like a giant mirror! Mom held Bubu's hand and said gently: "Look how beautiful it is." Bubu opened her mouth wide, eyes sparkling: "What a beautiful lake!"

pages.text: 爸爸开始搭帐篷。咘咘跑过来「帮忙」，抓住一根帐篷杆摇来摇去。帐篷歪歪扭扭地倒了下来，正好盖在爸爸头上！「哈哈哈哈！」咘咘笑得前仰后合。爸爸从帐篷布里钻出来，头上还顶着一根杆子，也笑了：「我的小帮手呀！」
pages.text_en: Dad started setting up the tent. Bubu ran over to "help," grabbing a tent pole and shaking it back and forth. The tent wobbled and collapsed right on top of Dad! "Hahahaha!" Bubu laughed so hard she could barely stand. Dad poked his head out from under the tent fabric with a pole still on his head, laughing too: "My little helper!"

pages.text: 帐篷终于搭好了！咘咘拉着NOMI跑到湖边。她们蹲下来，看到水里有小鱼游来游去。「看！小鱼！」咘咘伸手想去抓，NOMI轻轻拉住她：「小心哦，别掉进水里。」咘咘又捡起一块圆圆的小石头：「好漂亮！我要带回家！」
pages.text_en: The tent was finally set up! Bubu pulled NOMI and ran to the lake. They squatted down and saw little fish swimming around. "Look! Fish!" Bubu reached out to grab one, but NOMI gently held her back: "Be careful, don't fall in." Bubu picked up a round little stone: "So pretty! I'm taking it home!"

pages.text: Coco走过来，指着湖水说：「Look, Bubu! This is a lake! Can you say lake?」咘咘歪着小脑袋：「Lake！」Coco又指着天上的太阳：「And that's the sun!」咘咘大声说：「Sun！」NONO在旁边拍翅膀：「还有我！Bird！」大家都笑了。
pages.text_en: Coco walked over and pointed at the water: "Look, Bubu! This is a lake! Can you say lake?" Bubu tilted her little head: "Lake!" Coco pointed at the sun: "And that's the sun!" Bubu said loudly: "Sun!" NONO flapped his wings nearby: "And me! Bird!" Everyone laughed.

pages.text: Coco继续教：「那边是sky——天空！还有trees——树！」咘咘认真地跟着说：「Sky！Trees！」然后她张开双臂，转了一个圈：「Happy！」Coco开心地鼓掌：「Yes! You are happy! Very good, Bubu!」
pages.text_en: Coco continued teaching: "Over there is the sky! And those are trees!" Bubu repeated carefully: "Sky! Trees!" Then she spread her arms and spun in a circle: "Happy!" Coco clapped happily: "Yes! You are happy! Very good, Bubu!"

pages.text: 中午了，一家人坐在折叠椅上休息。阳光暖暖的洒下来，微风轻轻吹过湖面。爸爸戴着遮阳帽，舒服地眯起了眼睛。妈妈靠在椅子上看湖景，嘴角带着微笑。NOMI窝在椅子旁边翻一本书，NONO站在椅背上打了个小哈欠。
pages.text_en: At noon, the whole family sat in folding chairs to rest. Warm sunshine poured down and a gentle breeze blew across the lake. Dad wore his sun hat and squinted comfortably. Mom leaned back in her chair gazing at the lake with a smile. NOMI curled up beside a chair reading a book, and NONO perched on a chair back, giving a tiny yawn.

pages.text: 妈妈打开野餐篮，拿出三明治、水果和果汁。「来，开饭啦！」咘咘接过三明治，咬了一大口：「好好吃！」Coco拿着一杯果汁说：「Yummy! This is delicious!」咘咘跟着说：「Yummy！」NOMI小心翼翼地往三明治上加了一片黄瓜，NONO叼了一颗蓝莓飞到树枝上吃。
pages.text_en: Mom opened the picnic basket and took out sandwiches, fruits, and juice. "Come, time to eat!" Bubu grabbed a sandwich and took a big bite: "So yummy!" Coco held a cup of juice: "Yummy! This is delicious!" Bubu repeated: "Yummy!" NOMI carefully added a cucumber slice to her sandwich, and NONO grabbed a blueberry and flew to a branch to eat it.

pages.text: 下午的阳光越来越温柔。咘咘躺在爸爸旁边的小椅子上，手里还握着那颗湖边捡的小石头。Coco坐在旁边，轻轻地说：「Bubu, look at the lake. So beautiful, so peaceful.」咘咘眯着眼睛，小声说：「Beautiful……」
pages.text_en: The afternoon sunshine grew softer and softer. Bubu lay in a small chair next to Dad, still holding the little stone from the lake. Coco sat nearby and said softly: "Bubu, look at the lake. So beautiful, so peaceful." Bubu squinted her eyes and whispered: "Beautiful..."

pages.text: 傍晚，太阳慢慢落下去了。湖面变成了金色的，像铺了一层闪闪发光的毯子。全家人坐在湖边，看着夕阳一点一点沉进远处的山后面。咘咘靠在妈妈怀里，小声说：「妈妈，好美呀……」妈妈亲了亲她的额头：「嗯，和咘咘在一起，什么都美。」
pages.text_en: In the evening, the sun slowly set. The lake turned golden, like a blanket of sparkling light. The whole family sat by the lake, watching the sun sink behind the distant mountains. Bubu leaned against Mom and whispered: "Mama, it's so beautiful..." Mom kissed her forehead: "Yes, everything is beautiful when we're with Bubu."

pages.text: 天黑了，该回家啦。爸爸收好帐篷和椅子，妈妈把东西都装上车。咘咘抱着NOMI上了车，Coco和NONO也跳了进来。车子慢慢开动了，窗外的星星一闪一闪的。
pages.text_en: It was dark now, time to go home. Dad packed up the tent and chairs, and Mom loaded everything into the car. Bubu hugged NOMI and climbed in. Coco and NONO hopped in too. The car slowly started moving, and stars twinkled outside the window.

pages.text: 没过多久，咘咘就在车后座睡着了。她的小嘴角带着微笑，手里还紧紧握着那颗湖边捡的小石头。NOMI轻轻帮她盖上小毯子，NONO安静地站在椅背上守着她。Coco小声说：「Good night, Bubu. Sweet dreams.」窗外的月亮又大又圆，照着回家的路，温柔地说：晚安。
pages.text_en: Before long, Bubu fell asleep in the back seat. A little smile played on her lips, and she still clutched the little stone from the lake. NOMI gently tucked a blanket over her, and NONO quietly stood guard on the headrest. Coco whispered: "Good night, Bubu. Sweet dreams." Outside, a big round moon lit the way home, softly saying: goodnight.
